about: After a 120px in-flow block at the top of the app root shrinks the board and is removed with no re-render, the Play, Review and Puzzles boards come back to at least their fresh width within 3.5 s, nothing overflows, and a board nothing disturbed does not move at rest. Graded by gate 125 (TC-R201a..c) with CT_G125_GEOS=kunal761,375x667,se. NOT COVERED: a real app transient (a message that shrinks, a row that leaves) rather than the synthetic block; the idle wake's CPU and battery cost (a 600 ms poll while a fit screen is idle); wide/landscape and lessons (outside the wake by design); Kunal's own phone.

breaks.name: the-idle-wake-never-fires
breaks.why: the 600 ms idle check returns at once, so once the loop has stopped nothing re-arms it and the board stays trimmed - the job's defect

breaks.name: the-wake-asks-only-about-overflow
breaks.why: the wake fires only when the content overflows, not when a trimmed board has room to grow back, which is the state a transient leaves behind

breaks.name: the-loop-never-says-it-is-idle
breaks.why: the fit loop runs its passes but never marks itself idle, so the idle check (which only acts on an idle loop) never acts
